brief_extract: The Royal Infirmary at Chester, for instance, is now celebrating the 200th anniversary of the admission of its first in-patient, and on the 25th October, 1955, the Caernarvonshire and Anglesey General Hospital at Bangor had been in existence for 145 years, and it can therefore claim to be one of the oldest hospitals in Wales.
